format: plan v2: MONEY (points 0.5, max 3) + WINS (game-line favourites, max 2) + 0-1 parlay + $0 track shelf; one bet per game
ranking: MONEY: price closest to -110 among +EV qualifiers; WINS: highest no-vig within 58-78%
note: NEW PLAN (v2), adopted Nov 15 after a 10-agent rebuild. Every probability now starts from Pinnacle's no-vig price. The old blends, learned biases and H1-H18 filters are retired. Card lanes: MONEY (up to 3 points 0.5 props, both sides, priced -167 to +130, only where our model is 2-8 pts above Pinnacle and the bet is +EV; on probation with a kill switch), WINS (up to 2 game-line favourites: moneyline, +1.5 or main total with a 58-78% no-vig chance, nothing shorter than -330, labelled as costing ~2-4%), PARLAY (0-1, two legs from different games, built only from qualifying legs, priced +-125 to +300), and a $0 TRACK shelf for shots, assists and goals props (plus bet365 value flags for friends). One bet per game, flat stakes, 0-2 bet nights are allowed. Tonight's card builds at the 1:30 PM ET price pull (props and three of the five games are not posted yet) and is re-checked at 6:15 PM after goalies confirm.
